snippet.title: Snap & Print - Run Your Wholesome Photo Booth Business - Gameplay Teaser (Steam)
snippet.description:
Run the cutest little photo & print shop in town! 📸 Snap & Print is a cozy job simulator, where you take portraits, edit and restore pictures, and decorate shots with hats, flowers, stickers, and more. Upgrade your studio, unlock new props, and make every customer smile.

Wishlist now to be notified for free demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3946330/Snap__Print/
